name: Slab surfaces
responsibility: Draws raised slabs and their shadows, selection seats and standing borders
description: Cards, icon chips, relationship labels and activation bars use these flat shapes. The header slab of a neutral container well uses the same slab function through tray.ts. Card and label shadows are painted in separate member-tagged groups below the lines and cards. Standing marks border the top face; no wash or hatch replaces the group tint.

outgoing.label: the palette type its functions consume
outgoing.description: Slab functions receive palette colors through the Palette contract imported from theme.ts.
